name: Afghanistan (Interim Administration, 2001–2002)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and black with the gold mosque-and-wheat emblem in the centre and the shahada in light blue Arabic script on either side of it.
history: Version of the 1992 Islamic State flag used after the Taliban were driven from Kabul on 13 November 2001, with the shahada added in blue on either side of the emblem. It was replaced on 27 January 2002 by the black, red and green tricolour of the Afghan Interim Administration.
